title: SafeImpute: Reliable Clinical Data Imputation via Conformal Selection
abstract: arXiv:2607.05613v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical care often relies on key laboratory indicators, yet real-world patient visits are sparse and tests are ordered irregularly, leading to pervasive missingness. While many imputation methods improve average accuracy, they provide limited guidance on which imputed values are reliable enough for high-stakes downstream use. In this work, we study reliable clinical imputation, aiming to produce accurate imputations while selectively releasing the reliable results, with statistical control over clinically unacceptable errors. To achieve this goal, we propose SafeImpute, a reliable imputation framework for irregular and sparse clinical longitudinal records. SafeImpute constructs an event graph that captures both intra-patient temporal trajectories and inter-patient clinical similarity, and learns imputations with a two-relation GNN and adaptive fusion, regularized by an auxiliary masked reconstruction objective. translated_title: SafeImpute：基于保形选择的可靠临床数据插补
translated_abstract: 临床护理通常依赖关键的实验室指标，然而现实世界中患者的就诊稀疏且检查安排不规律，导致数据普遍缺失。虽然许多插补方法提高了平均精度，但它们对于哪些插补值足够可靠以用于高风险下游应用提供的指导有限。在这项工作中，我们研究可靠的临床插补，旨在生成准确的插补结果，同时有选择地释放可靠的结果，并对临床不可接受的错误进行统计控制。为实现这一目标，我们提出了SafeImpute，一个面向不规则且稀疏的临床纵向记录的可靠插补框架。SafeImpute构建了一个事件图，同时捕捉患者内部的时间轨迹和患者之间的临床相似性，并通过双关系GNN和自适应融合学习插补，辅以辅助掩码重建目标进行正则化。为实现可靠性保证……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SafeImpute通过事件图和双关系图神经网络对稀疏不规则的临床纵向数据进行插补，并利用保形选择以统计保证的方式有选择地释放可靠的插补值，从而控制临床不可接受的错误。
en_tdlr: SafeImpute performs reliable imputation on sparse, irregular clinical longitudinal data using an event graph and a two-relation GNN, and selectively releases reliable imputed values via conformal selection with statistical control over clinically unacceptable errors.
